Chapter 861: Chapter 7: The Twelve Great Peak Powers of the Universe (Please Subscribe)_2

“The previous large-scale battlefield was reduced by the two-dimensional world within White Paper, with fewer than three hundred Level Eleven beings. Now, the number of Elevens in this super-large battlefield of different races has reached tens of thousands?”

Lin Yuan pondered silently.

“However, with my strength, once I enter, taking advantage of the fact that the supreme beings of different races have not reacted, *could I potentially take down these tens of thousands of Elevens in one-go?*”

Lin Yuan thought secretly.

The reason it was only potential was that he couldn’t be sure how many trump cards were hidden among these tens of thousands of Elevens by the supreme beings of different races.

The backhands of supreme beings were hard to gauge, at least the one Xia Qin’s supreme being gave Lin Yuan could deliver a strike with the power of tens of thousands, or even a hundred thousand.

If Xia Qin’s supreme being was like this, then surely the other supreme beings of different races have their arrangements as well.

But even if he couldn’t take them all in one sweep, Lin Yuan could still wantonly slaughter a significant number of Elevens and acquire numerous supreme weapons.

No one would ever have too many supreme weapons, especially since Lin Yuan was cultivating the “Xuanhuang Physique,” which had a high demand for resources.

To cultivate the “Xuanhuang Physique” to the Level Eleven Perfect state, even draining all the resources of the entire Human Civilization wouldn’t suffice, and he could only hope for the Myriad Clans on the battlefield.

This was just the Level Eleven Perfect state of the “Xuanhuang Physique.” If it were the Level Twelve Perfect state, it would probably consume even the entire universe’s resources and still not be enough.

…

“This time entering the battlefield, beware of that Tianyu Meng from the Tianyu Clan.”

While Lin Yuan was contemplating, the voice of Xia Qin’s supreme being reached him.

“Tianyu Meng?” Lin Yuan nodded slightly, as he had also heard of this Tianyu Clan member most likely to cross into the Twelfth Layer, the Heavenly Lord.

Bearing the bloodline of the first ancestor of the Tianyu Clan, the Tianyu Clan heavily valued bloodline inheritance, and many divine skills and talents were inherited through the bloodline.

The first ancestor’s bloodline? That meant Tianyu Meng’s talents were likely terrifying.

“Tianyu Meng is just that to you, but the key is that Angel Crown, which is one of the clan suppression weapons of the Tianyu Clan, and shockingly, the first ancestor has even used this foundation,” Xia Qin’s supreme being continued, with a hint of surprise in his tone.

The Human Civilization also bestowed numerous supreme weapons, but there was no intention to bestow clan suppression weapons, as the risk was too great.

If an extreme situation occurred and a regular supreme weapon was lost, it was just lost. But if a clan suppression weapon was lost, the impact on the ethnic group’s power would be unprecedented!

“Clan suppression weapon.”

Lin Yuan’s expression turned slightly solemn.

Renowned as a clan suppression weapon, it was stronger than ordinary supreme weapons. So far, the only clan suppression weapon of Human Civilization Lin Yuan had encountered was the “Void Realm World.”

On the Ancestral Star of Human Civilization, there was also a clan suppression weapon, but Lin Yuan didn’t know which one it was.

“There are also powerful figures from the Universe Clan and Zhou Clan…”

Xia Qin’s supreme being began to introduce Lin Yuan further.

Human Civilization was one of the twelve peak ethnic group powers, and the Universe Clan and Zhou Clan were also two peak ethnic groups among them.

In fact, at the dawn of the universe, there were no Universe Clan or Zhou Clan, only one Universe Clan.

The Universe Clan was then the most powerful force, ruling vast millions of years from the birth of the universe. However, something unknown ultimately caused a split within the Universe Clan, forming the Universe Clan and Zhou Clan.

Both the Universe Clan and Zhou Clan inherited part of the heritage of the original Universe Clan. Although not as formidable as the former Universe Clan, they were still inscrutable and occupied a transcendent status among the twelve peak powers.

Even Human Civilization was not keen to fully antagonize the Universe Clan or Zhou Clan, as who could tell if the two peak ethnic groups would merge back into one and revive the glory of the Universe Clan.

“And there’s the Robber Clan, you need to be cautious, this ethnic group is even more mysterious than any special life form…” Xia Qin’s supreme being’s tone grew grave, a seriousness not apparent even when discussing the Universe Clan and Zhou Clan.

If the Universe Clan and Zhou Clan originated from the dawn of the universe, then the Robber Clan supposedly hailed from a previous Cosmic Era.

At the end of a Cosmic Era, the universe would naturally collapse and be destroyed, the river of time would dry up, only supreme beings had a chance of surviving and entering the Chaos Void.

Yet the Robber Clan was an exception, this ethnic group somehow avoided the ultimate destruction and collapse of the last Cosmic Era, successfully entering this Cosmic Era.

Therefore, the Robber Clan suffered malice from the entire Cosmic Starry Skies’ Origin Rules Grand Path.

The Robber Clan got the name “Robber” because the members of this ethnic group, from birth, had to face many calamities invisibly imposed by the universe’s origin rules.

Among the twelve peak ethnic groups, the Robber Clan had the fewest members, far fewer than the special lives within the Star Alliance.

However, the ones who survived from the Robber Clan were undoubtedly powerful. Surviving under the targeting of the universe’s origin rules and growing, how terrifying is that?

Currently, the Robber Clan had only two Twelfth Layer ultimates, the fewest among the twelve peak ethnic groups, yet there was no ethnic group power willing to provoke the Robber Clan.

…

“Robber Clan…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts expanded.

Surviving from the last Cosmic Era to this one?

Even for Twelfth Layer ultimates, it was impossible.

The universe collapses and is destroyed, and supreme beings barely have time to escape towards the Chaos Void as best they can.

Remaining in the universe to face endless destructive power?

The only existence Lin Yuan knew of that could survive one Cosmic Era after another was the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm was thoroughly integrated into the universe’s origin, and its collapse would not affect the realm.

But the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was the handiwork of the Chaos Realm’s Xuanhuang.

And the Xuanhuang Beast within it couldn’t enter the Cosmic Starry Skies, yet the Robber Clan could roam the universe?

…

Time slowly passed.

Days went by.

Outside the super-large battlefield, towering presences appeared one after another, the Twelfth Layer ultimates from other peak ethnic powers arriving.

“Almost time to enter the battlefield,”

Xia Qin’s supreme being looked towards the many Level Eleven strong ones, “You all should be clear about the rules within the battlefield by now, right?”

Regarding the rules inside the super-large battlefield, Xia Qin’s supreme being had explained in detail before they arrived.

Any Level Eleven strong ones entering the super-large battlefield would arrive at the fringe areas of the battlefield.

The fringe area consisted of 333 regions, and in some part of each area, there was a Space-Time Path. Once entering this Space-Time Path, one could proceed to the core area of the battlefield.

Outside this Space-Time Path, there was a Spatial-Temporal Maze, and only by passing through this maze could one reach the Space-Time Path.

The Space-Time Path in each region had a limit on the number of entries; it would close upon admitting one hundred Level Elevens.

In other words, to enter the Space-Time Path and reach the core area of the battlefield, one had to compete with other Elevens within the same area.

Only the first hundred could proceed to the battlefield’s core area.

Ordinarily, the Level Eleven strong ones arriving in the fringe areas were randomly placed, thus introducing an element of luck.

If some Elevens from the same clan or alliance landed in the same fringe area, they could work together to enter the Space-Time Path securely.

Alternatively, if many with supreme weapons landed in a particular area, then some spots for entering the Space-Time Path would be internally decided.

For the remaining Elevens to get in, they would face escalating fierce competition.

To the peak ethnic groups, the real battles on the super-large battlefield were in the core area. As for the fringe areas? They were just appetizers before the real fight.

“Of the 333 fringe areas, in the area where the Galaxy Master is present, all Level Elevens from the Human Civilization Alliance follow the Galaxy Master’s orders,”

Xia Qin’s supreme being reiterated one last time.

“All Level Elevens from the Human Civilization Alliance?”

Among the different races’ Elevens, some strong characters took note of the ‘prefix’ Xia Qin’s supreme being mentioned.

It referred to Level Elevens from the Human Civilization Alliance and not those from the Xia You Evolution Tower?
